svg.text: Frontend Guard vs Backend Authorization – Visual Guide
Angular · A08 · Guards stop honest users. curl is the API's job.
401 is who. 403 is permission. Guard is UX.
A crafted HTTP call never hits your menu.
Guard for the page. [Authorize] for Delete.
401 to login. 403 is not a refresh.
Internal API is still a public HTTP surface.

text.tspan: The API is internal so guards are enough.
Any client can call the API.
UI is not the source of truth.
If they ask which is sufficient: only the

svg.text: Both layers; server is the source of truth.

text.tspan: Say what curl without Angular still cannot do
401 → login; 403 → message, no retry as another user
Silently retry 403 as a different user
